messages:
Alana (CS): quick heads-up — PioneerHealth week0 kickoff is today. Blocker: their security team won't approve KMS key policy until we demonstrate immutable audit log forwarding to their Splunk tenant. Also they called out a rotation window conflict with their SOC calendar. pinging @Olivia (Security) and @Devon (SE) for help.

Devon (SE): understood. do we already have a sample CloudTrail->Splunk forwarder config I can share? if not, I can paste a minimal example.

Alana (CS): they also asked for explicit 2yr retention proof. customer asked: "what if logs get lost during cutover?" — that's starting to register as a renewal risk unless we close this quickly.

Olivia (Security): i can run a 30-min security review with their appsec folks. we should provide the audit-forwarding diagram + our SLA for delivery/retry. also need a KMS key policy example that restricts decrypt to their VPC endpoints only.

Devon (SE): dropping quick snippets here for review, will formalize into docs later:
```
# CloudTrail -> Splunk forwarder (simplified)
forwarder:
  input: cloudtrail_s3_bucket
  output: splunk_hec://splunk-pilot.example.com:8088
  retries: 5
  backoff_ms: 3000
  transform: timestamp, eventName, sourceIPAddress
```
```json
// KMS key policy (excerpt)
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowDecryptFromVPC",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pioneerhealth-forwarder"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0a1b2c3d4e"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Raj (Ops): fyi during our dry-run yesterday we observed ~3 dropped events when the forwarder returned intermittent 503s. fixed by increasing retries and jitter. i've added steps to the runbook and a recovery play: /runbooks/pioneerhealth-forwarder.md 

Alana (CS): action items: 1) @Devon formalize docs + diagram and send to customer by EOD. 2) @Olivia set up the 30-min security review with their appsec — target tomorrow PDT. 3) @Raj validate runbook restore steps and confirm retention verification. tagging @Priya (Renewals) — this is a potential "medium-high" renewal risk until audit-forwarding + retention are confirmed.

deploy-bot: Reminder — PioneerHealth week0 dry-run milestone is tomorrow 11:00 PDT.

Priya (Renewals): noted. marking as "monitoring" in CRM and will follow up after Olivia's review. if customer still has open objections after review i'll propose a short executive join to unblock. :+1:

Alana (CS): thanks team — i'll keep the thread updated as we close items.
